sources.title: GitHub - WeZZard/jlens-qwen36: J-space / Jacobian-lens visualizer for ...
sources.snippet: A visual debugger for a local Qwen3.6-27B (4-bit) on Apple Silicon / MLX. It fits a Jacobian lens and shows which words the model is pushing toward at every layer and token position. Try it live at jlens.wezzard.com — a read-only presentation mode of this project, running in the browser. Every conversation has a shareable URL.
